arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Each problem has a row, a column, the expected type, and the text that failed.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
parsed <- read_csv(I("x\n1\nb"), col_types = "d")
found <- problems(parsed)
paste(paste(found$row, found$col, found$expected, found$actual, sep = "/"), collapse = ",")
